lines.text: Most AI edits look fake. You can spot them in one second. Here's why.
One. Generic stock footage. The same clips everyone else uses.
Two. Robotic pacing. Every cut lands on the same beat, like a metronome.
Three. Captions that shout. Every word bouncing. Every word yellow.
Four. No point of view. It says everything, and means nothing.
The fix isn't more AI. It's more you. Your footage. Your timing. Your opinion.
Let AI do the clicking. You keep the taste. Follow for more vibe editing.
